#include "ara/per/file_storage.h"
Description:
Reset the whole file storage, including all files.
This method allows to reset a file storage to the initial state, containing only the files which were
deployed from the manifest, with their initial content. It will fail with a kResourceBusyError when
the file storage is currently open.
